history.title: WWII: young men of the 1920s drafted
history.text: Vasile Popescu died in October 1944 and Gavril Marin (b. 1920) was of military age. Check military service records.

history.title: First television in the family
history.text: Family story: half the street came over to watch. Year from memory.

Popescu.meaning: Of the priest's family: popă (priest) + -escu (belonging to, descended from).
Popescu.origin: Romanian, most common in Wallachia and Oltenia, where -escu names are typical. Today the most frequent surname in Romania.

changes.text: People were usually known by a father's name or a nickname, e.g. Ion al lui Popa (Ion, son of the priest).
-escu forms spread as family names, first among boyars and townspeople, then everyone.
The Romanian law on names made family names fixed and hereditary.

Marin.meaning: From the given name Marin, Latin Marinus: of the sea.
Marin.origin: A father's first name turned surname (patronymic). Found across Romania and the Balkans.

changes.text: Likely began as Marin's son; the -escu form Marinescu is the same name made formal.
